name: Badge
tagline: A personal networking badge that matches students with sponsors and people who share their career interests.
problem: At hackathons and career fairs, students approach sponsors blind with generic questions.
solution: Builds each user's professional profile and matches them to sponsors and peers, highlighting what about each company relates to them.
demo_moment: Team-described: open your badge and see which sponsors to talk to and why.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Snowflake API” among 160 submissions.
Solves a problem the team saw at the event itself.

lessons: A problem the judges are watching happen in the room needs no persuasion.
